_comment: Master list for the Resource Center. Add a file to assets/downloads/, add an entry here, then run tools/build.py. File sizes are read from disk at build time and never hand-written.

groups.title: Gospel Tracts
groups.intro: Print-ready evangelism tracts used in street outreach and door-to-door ministry. Download the PDF to print and share, or the Word version if you need to adapt the contact details for your own assembly.

items.title: You May Not Feel Lost… But You Need Rescue
items.description: A three-panel tract for people who are comfortable but disconnected from God. Walks through spiritual death, the need for a rescuer, God's rescue plan, and a prayer of surrender.

items.title: Are You Ready to Meet Your Maker?
items.description: An apologetics-leaning tract addressing the reality of judgment, the evidence of a Creator, and the invitation of the cross. Suited to thoughtful sceptics and open-air conversations.

items.title: The Call to Truly Believe
items.description: A fuller gospel presentation moving from creation and purpose, through the fall and God's mercy, to the invitation to come to the Saviour. Useful as a follow-up for new believers.

groups.title: Outreach & Invitation Materials
groups.intro: Print artwork used for street evangelism, neighbourhood visitation, and outdoor signage. Send these files straight to a print shop, or use them as templates for your own outreach.

items.title: Door Hanger. Sunday Service (Navy)
items.description: Neighbourhood door hanger carrying Sunday service and midweek Bible study details. Print-ready artwork at full bleed.

items.title: Door Hanger. Sunday Service (Green)
items.description: Alternate colourway of the neighbourhood door hanger, for rotating outreach rounds or a second design run.

items.title: Yard Sign, “Jesus Is Coming Soon!”
items.description: The Believers Call street-evangelism placard artwork, supplied as print-ready PDF for yard signs and hand-held boards.

items.title: Outdoor Banner, 3ft × 5ft
items.description: Large-format banner artwork sized for a standard 3ft by 5ft outdoor print, for use at services, crusades, and community events.

items.title: Feather Flag Artwork
items.description: Three feather-flag designs for pavement and forecourt use, carrying service times and invitation messaging.
